Maya Patel: Announcing preview: Private Conformance Checker for VPC/On‑Prem customers. Small preview starting next week for customers who require automated compliance checks against our serving runtime without sending policy details out of the VPC.

Jordan Lee: Short tech summary: a local binary shipped with the agent that runs a configurable set of conformance tests (networking, kernel flags, package hashes, config hygiene) and writes a signed results bundle to a customer S3 endpoint. If the customer opts in, the agent can publish a signed summary (pass/fail + rule hashes) to the control plane; raw bundles stay in the customer bucket.

Maya Patel: Why this matters: helps customers meet audit windows faster; reduces manual evidence collection; lets enterprise security teams verify runtime posture before onboarding.

Priya Shah: Preview scope: - Conformance rule library (80% of common checks) - Signed result bundles + rule-hash attestations - Console view for aggregated pass/fail (meta only) - CLI: `redwood-conform run --rules default --out s3://tenant-a/conform/`

Jordan Lee: Limitations: no live remediation in preview, no cross-tenant aggregation, and plugin checks (custom scripts) are disabled until we ship a sandboxed runner.

ops-bot: preview image built: ghcr.io/redwood/conform-checker:preview-2026-04-20

Maya Patel: Customer invites: 6 pilot seats for customers with SOC2/FedRAMP needs. Pilot includes onboarding run, three scheduled conformance scans, and a follow-up checklist. If you manage customers who should be invited, DM me the account and primary contact.

Priya Shah: Action items: Product to finalize the onboarding doc (Maya), Eng to add ruleset signing support (Jordan), Support to draft customer-facing FAQs (Alex). Please add to the private-conformance board by EOD tomorrow.

Maya Patel: Signup link: https://forms.redwood.com/private-conformance-preview (deadline 2026-04-05). Questions welcome here or via DM. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
